observations: Paired original and augmented trajectories were viewed at full sheet resolution. Sampled transformed shapes stay close to their originals without visible new detached spikes or omitted strokes.

Some originals themselves are visually ambiguous across classes, for example cursive letters versus digits. Labels are inherited from admitted source annotation, not inferred from this visual inspection.
Sample inspection is not semantic validation of every generated view; class-preserving deformation remains an explicit experimental assumption.
